Subject: Invitation to Speak at the Future of Tech Conference

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of the organizing committee for the upcoming Future of Tech Conference, scheduled to take place on [Date] in [Location]. We are currently finalizing our lineup of keynote speakers and would be honored to have you join us.

The theme of this year’s conference is "Innovation in the Age of AI," focusing on the ethical implications and practical applications of artificial intelligence across various industries. Given your extensive work in [Speaker's Specific Field/Topic] and your recent publication on [Relevant Book or Article], we believe you would be an exceptional fit for our audience. Your insights would provide tremendous value to our attendees, who are primarily industry leaders, developers, and policy makers.

We would like to invite you to deliver a 45-minute keynote address followed by a 15-minute Q&A session. In recognition of your time and expertise, we are offering a speaking fee of $[Amount]. Additionally, we will cover all travel and accommodation expenses for your stay.

Please let us know if you are interested in this opportunity or if you would like to discuss the details further. We are happy to accommodate your schedule and any specific requirements you may have.

Thank you for considering our invitation. We look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to the conference.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Organization]
[Contact Information]
